findings.why: There is no unit Z. The unit numbers are cut off at the left edge, and the 3rd Floor row's label is a clipped '2' that can look like 'Z'.
The 3rd Floor row has a clipped '2' label, and its Offering Price shows 500,000.
The 4th fl/5th fl row has a clipped '3' label, and its Offering Price shows 775,000. The notes refer to Units 1 and 3.

read_problems: Beds/baths given as combined "No. of Bedrooms/Bathrooms" codes (e.g. "5/2 & 2 halves") rather than separate beds and baths columns; transcribed as printed into the beds column, baths column set to "-" since not separately stated.
Unit numbers printed only as unclear symbols (e.g. "⌐", "⊐") in the Unit No. column on page 18; inferred as 1, 2, 3 based on row order and location column.
Page 19 contains no Schedule A price table (only explanatory notes); no rows transcribed from it.
